title: Upgrade Manager to a revisioned effective registry
objective: Make skills.Manager expose immutable revisioned snapshots by stable ID while preserving compatibility for existing name-based consumers.
context: Implement the accepted hybrid skill catalog design in the dirty shared worktree.
Registry state is authoritative; prompt messages are an append-only model projection and never the authorization boundary.

source_evidence.note: Bounded metadata catalog and on-demand full skill content.
Live discovery and four-state skill visibility controls.
Append-only messages preserve the prior cached prefix.

include: Retain every discovered stable-ID entry instead of discarding same-name alternatives.
Resolve one effective winner per invocation name with explicit shadowing metadata.
Integrate content digest, catalog revision, effective policy, and override source.

Define a transport-neutral InvocationOrigin model/user enum and use it in a single linearizable ResolveLatest execution lookup so command and tool layers cannot infer origin or perform split Get/IsEnabled checks.

Define a validated SkillExecutionReceipt metadata contract carrying context epoch, stable ID, content digest, rendered payload digest, and envelope kind so task_16 can emit it and task_19 can commit the loaded ledger only after the result is appended to visible history.

Own ToggleProjectVisibility(sessionID, stable SkillID, expected catalog revision): reject active session overrides, persist the project record, apply it to live state, and return the authoritative row/result.

Do not publish a partial live revision: persistence failure leaves live state unchanged; live-apply failure attempts persistent rollback; rollback failure returns degraded-refresh-required with a newly read authoritative snapshot.
Provide race-safe Snapshot/Resolve APIs and compatibility Get/All adapters.
exclude: Do not modify files owned by another task.
Do not add dependencies or perform unrelated refactors.

implementation_steps: Refactor Manager internal indexes under its existing lock.
Advance revision only when effective catalog state changes.
Add same-name, refresh, override, concurrent snapshot/invoke, and compatibility tests.
acceptance_criteria: Unchanged rescans do not advance revision.
Snapshot is immutable to callers and deterministic.
Project toggles are compare-and-swap safe by stable ID and observed revision; filtered/stale/same-name rows cannot target another skill.
Managed or session-overridden skills reject interactive project toggles without changing either scope.
Every partial failure reports committed, rejected, or degraded-refresh-required truthfully and includes enough state for the UI to redraw authoritatively.
Legacy Get/All behavior remains compatible until consumers migrate.
risks: loader.go is already modified in the shared worktree; preserve user changes and avoid broad rewrites.
dispatch_prompt: Upgrade only skills/loader.go to the revisioned stable-ID registry contract and add a new focused test file. Preserve legacy consumers.
notes_for_assignee: Respect owned_files. Escalate contract gaps to the integration owner rather than editing another task's production files.
